value.rationale: C5 is the minimal odd noncomplete cyclic graph, hence the first natural odd-cycle test beyond path and complete-graph cohomology calculations. Determining all 11 graded rational D5-representations and both quotient Betti vectors is significant structural information beyond any total Betti bound, and the orientation twist supplies a meaningful group-equivariant duality check. The invariant is natural, complete and reusable even without a general cycle theorem; publication priority remains subject to independent review.
